mentions.name: xllify
mentions.description: This tool extends Excel with custom functions by embedding the Luau language on top of the old C SDK, so the same bytecode runs as native Windows XLL add-ins and as WASM-based web add-ins, giving native performance without extra work. AI is used only during authoring, producing a standalone artifact, and an included xllify Assistant add-in brings a conversational coding assistant directly into Excel.
mentions.problem: Many approaches for writing custom Excel functions are unacceptably slow, particularly when their inputs come from fast-moving realtime data feeds.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Delving deep into novel ways to extend Excel and make it more accessible. Perhaps different approach to copilot in that AI is only used during authoring, the yielded output being a standalone artifact.

The result is https://xllify.com

It embeds Luau which tames the very old school C SDK. This means that the same code can run as native add-ins on Windows (XLL) and the more modern-but-far-slower web engine, thanks to WASM. Luau is safe and fast.
